shared_elements: single human figure as dominant subject
frontal or profile face with prominent eyes
body with garment/costume elements indicated by incised lines
justification: Both depict a single elaborately costumed human figure filling a rounded-topped rectangular field, with a headdress, a prominent circular ear ornament beside the face and a disc ornament on the chest — a reasonably specific shared scheme of an ornamented dignitary portrait. However, A is a spare, minimally incised bust in strict profile with only a few line-defined garment folds, while B is a densely packed, near-frontal full-length standing figure encrusted with subsidiary masks, scrolls and secondary figures, so the density, viewpoint and completeness of the figure differ greatly.
